当前账号在这些地方处于登录状态: Where your account is signed in
退出其他所有设备？: Sign out of all other devices?
这些设备需要重新登录。: They'll need to sign in again.
该设备下一次操作时会回到登录页。: It goes back to the sign-in page on its next action.
登录时除了密码，还需要输入手机验证器 App 上的动态验证码: Signing in also asks for a code from the authenticator app on your phone
管理员已暂停两步验证：登录时暂不需要验证码，绑定会保留: An administrator has paused two-step verification: sign-in doesn't ask for a code for now, and your setup is kept
你所在的角色要求开启两步验证，下次登录时会要求绑定: Your role requires two-step verification; you'll be asked to set it up at your next sign-in
开启后即使密码泄露，别人也无法登录你的账号: Even if your password leaks, nobody else can sign in to your account
用验证器 App 扫码绑定: Scan with an authenticator app to set it up
关闭后登录只需要密码，现有恢复码全部作废: Signing in will only need your password, and your recovery codes stop working
旧的恢复码将全部作废: Your current recovery codes will stop working
密码已修改，其他设备已退出登录: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
修改成功后，其他设备需要用新密码重新登录: Your other devices will need to sign in again with the new password
使用它的脚本或系统会立即无法调用接口。: Scripts and systems using it lose API access at once.
脚本和其他系统带上 Token 调用接口，只能使用这里勾选的权限: Scripts and other systems call the API with the token, limited to the permissions checked here
你还没有可以授予的权限: You have no permissions to grant
只能勾选自己拥有的权限；之后你的权限变少时，Token 的权限也随之变少: Only permissions you have can be granted; if you lose one later, the token loses it too
给脚本或其他系统调用接口用，请求头带上 Authorization: Beare: For scripts and other systems calling the API: send Authorization: Bearer <Token>
管理员已关闭 API Token，下面的 Token 暂时不能使用，重新开启后恢: An administrator turned API tokens off. The tokens below don’t work until they’re turned back on.
Token 只显示这一次，关闭后无法再查看。请立即复制并妥善保存；泄露时到这里吊: The token is shown only this once. Copy it now and keep it safe; if it leaks, revoke it here.
